events.event: Adversarial review launched on the integrated product (3059bde: 274/275 pass, 0 fail)
events.details: Three independent reviewer sessions: money/approvals/auth, who gets called (gate, consent, DPDP, minors), what she says (safety door TS and Python parity, voice runtime, operator injection). Each confirmed finding lands as a failing test marked todo in product/tests/review/, and owners fix their own modules.

campaigns: number.list and member.phone.verify_start/confirm (voice OTP, rate-limited per member, number and workspace). agents: a server-owned, industry-neutral practice-caller library (simcaller.list/save). calls: test.browser_call useDraft compiles through brief.compile, because agents stores the draft as a bare AgentConfig. web: Playwright flows for the unverified A2 paths.
